Shatterforge · the Quarter

    
The Quarter: nine lots of real buildings at real scale

    
A Doric temple of marble, a Roman aqueduct, the Villa Savoye, the Farnsworth House, a medieval timber barn, a brick mill with its chimney and a steel water tower, a market hall, a brick tenement and a ten-storey office tower: each built member by member at its real size, of its real material, and each stands and fails by its own structure. Walk in, climb, and take them apart. What comes off is simulated on the GPU as rigid pieces and rubble.

    

      
Mouse
look (click the view first)

      
W A S D
walk · Shift to run · Space to jump

      
F
fly mode on/off · Q / E down / up while flying

      
V
engineer's view: load against strength as colour, and the building's sag drawn larger

      
Click
blast at the crosshair

      
1 2 3
blast radius 0.4 / 0.7 / 1.2 m

      
4
fire a steel ball instead (it goes on through what it breaks)

      
Esc
menu: level, reset, graphics and physics settings, tools

      
R R
reset the level (R twice)

      
K
run the benchmark (reloads the page, then reports)
